A complete description of one **mold_v0** application (an MCP product: workspaces, keys, an MCP connector, an admin console, and the packs' records and runs).

kind.markdownDescription:
- `tool` (default): people open the app itself.
- `embedded`: the app runs **inside another product**; it then needs `developer_surface` and `audit.platform: true`.

product.markdownDescription: The brand people see. **name, colour and logo are required**: every new app is branded before its first deploy, never shipped under the mold's default name. `branding.py` derives the rest (palette, icon, sign-in mark) from these three.

agent_icon.x-hint: brands/acme/agent.svg, or icon:robot (a name from the console's icon set)
agent_icon.description: The workspace agent's own icon (optional): an SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP of at most 256 KB, a path from the factory's root, or icon:<name> from the console's icon set (Tabler's outline icons). Unset: the default icon.
agent_icon.markdownDescription: The workspace agent's own icon on the top bar and the agent pages (optional; shown while `features.agent_harness` is on): a file from the factory's root (`brands/<name>/agent.svg`, or a `.png`, `.jpg`, `.webp`; at most 256 KB), or `icon:<name>` from the console's icon set (Tabler's outline icons, e.g. `icon:robot`). onprem_runners.title: On-premises runners (mold_v0-205)
onprem_runners.description: true: the app's workspaces may install an on-premises runner inside their own network for the kinds that need it (a pack's job kind with private_network: true); false (the default): no runner routes, pages, tabs or enrolment, and every run is hosted.
onprem_runners.markdownDescription:
**On-premises runners**, off unless `true` (mold_v0-205, the shell's `src/onprem-runners.ts`).

- `true`: a workspace's owners add a runner on **Credentials** and install it inside their network; the runs of a kind with `private_network: true` then go to it when the workspace chooses so.
- `false` or absent: `/api/runners` and `/api/runner` answer not found, no console page, admin tab or guide page for runners appears, enrolment is refused and every run is hosted.

Brief line: `onprem_runners = true` in `## Profile`.

run_sandbox.title: Where the runs' sandboxes come from (mold_v0-274)
run_sandbox.description: auto (boat when its key is in Key vault, else the server's Docker), boat, docker or freestyle (a Freestyle VM per run and per agent wake). The default of the app's Sandbox provider setting: a staff member's choice and the server's APP_RUN_SANDBOX win over it.
run_sandbox.markdownDescription:
**Where each run's sandbox comes from** (mold_v0-274, the shell's `src/run-sandboxes.ts`): the default of the app's **Sandbox provider** platform setting (Admin › Agent configuration), which a staff member's choice and the server's `APP_RUN_SANDBOX` win over.

- `auto` (the default): boat when its key is in Key vault, else the server's Docker.
- `boat`: a boat.dev sandbox per run.
- `docker`: a container on the app's own server.
- `freestyle`: a Freestyle VM per run and per agent wake; its API key goes in the app's Key vault (Admin › Key vault, Freestyle), never in the repository or a pack.

Brief line: `run_sandbox = freestyle` in `## Profile`. `run_keys.sandbox = freestyle` implies it.

audit.title: Audit trails (mold_v0-197)
audit.description: Two audit trails, each on or off on its own (both default false). Separate from usage metering, which always stays on. mold_v0 writes it to the app's profile.audit (mold_v0-197, src/audit-trail.ts; entries kept 400 days unless profile.audit.retention_days says otherwise).
audit.markdownDescription:
Two audit trails, **each on or off on its own** (both default `false`).

- `data`: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
- `platform`: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus staff actions on accounts.

Separate from **usage metering**, which always stays on. An `embedded` app needs `platform: true`.

_mold_v0 writes it to the app's `profile.audit` (mold_v0-197, `src/audit-trail.ts`); entries are kept 400 days unless `profile.audit.retention_days` says otherwise._

data.description: Every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
data.markdownDescription: **Data audit trail**: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, shown to that workspace's admins. Default `false`.

platform.description: Every API/MCP request and sign-in, with key, actor and scope, plus staff actions on accounts. Required (true) for kind embedded.
platform.markdownDescription: **Platform audit trail**: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus platform staff's actions on accounts. Default `false`; **must be `true` when `kind` is `embedded`**.

sign.title: Chain and sign
sign.description: Signed checkpoints of the hash-chained trails (mold_v0-195): hourly Ed25519 signatures over Merkle roots, verifiable offline with the app's public key. Needs APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY in the app's environment.
